subject.title: fix(agents): block raw self-update package installs

question: Should agent exec reject every raw global OpenClaw package-manager command, or permit the documented stopped-Gateway manual recovery sequence when `openclaw update` cannot perform the update?
rationale: The PR changes an existing operational recovery contract rather than only fixing parser placement; current docs explicitly support manual package-manager recovery after stopping the managed Gateway.

options.title: Preserve explicit recovery
options.body: Centralize the guard and allow a narrowly validated stopped-Gateway recovery sequence while rejecting unsafe in-place package swaps.

options.title: Retire agent-assisted manual recovery
options.body: Keep a blanket exec ban, but explicitly update the public recovery contract and document the alternative when `openclaw update` fails.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit recovery
recommendation.body: Centralize the guard and allow a narrowly validated stopped-Gateway recovery sequence while rejecting unsafe in-place package swaps.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared exec-command guard and exec-boundary history makes this the strongest available owner for the behavioral contract.
